system.description:
OPDQ. Create up to 5 fragile illusions. An enemy attacking you must pass a CR 2 Smarts Check or it targets an illusion instead; one successful attack disperses an illusion. With Doppelgänger you may instead have up to 3 Doppelgängers and can move your consciousness into one when you die. Doom +1 per illusion created.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.69

automation.note: Track the illusions (max 5). Each enemy attacking you rolls Smarts CR 2 and hits an illusion on a failure, dispersing it. Doom +1 per illusion. Doppelgänger option: up to 3 Doppelgängers instead, and on death you may move into one.
